name: Orica Limited
summary: Orica Limited manufactures and distributes explosives, commercial blasting systems and specialty mining chemicals in Australia, Canada, the United States, and internationally. The company offers blasting solutions, including initiating systems, accessories, seismic products, packaged explosives, delivery systems, automation solutions, bulk systems, boosters, and related services and consulting services. It also provides digital solutions, including orebody intelligence, blast design and execution, and geosolutions.
